ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows quadrilateral ABCD, in the shape of a rhombus, with vertex A at the upper left, B at the upper right, C at the lower right, and D at the lower left. Diagonals AC and BD are drawn in the figure, and they intersect at point E; among them, BD is a side of triangle ABD, and E is located at the intersection point of the diagonals. Reasoning: The problem gives that ABCD is a rhombus, and m∠ABD = 55°. The four sides of a rhombus are all equal, so AB = AD. Therefore in triangle ABD, AB and AD are two equal sides, triangle ABD is an isosceles triangle, and the base is BD. The base angles of an isosceles triangle are equal, so ∠ABD = ∠BDA. It is known that ∠ABD = 55°, therefore m∠BDA = 55°. EB = 9 and AB = 12 do not need to be used to find this angle.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as rhombus ABCD with segment BD drawn, forming triangle ABD; E is the intersection of diagonals but is not needed. Hence m∠BDA = 55°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a rhombus ABCD with diagonal BD drawn from vertex B to opposite vertex D, passing through E. From the text, m∠ABD = 55°. In a rhombus, each diagonal bisects the angles at its endpoints, so BD bisects both ∠ABC and ∠ADC. Thus ∠ABD is half of angle B and ∠BDA is half of angle D. Opposite angles of a rhombus are equal, so their halves are equal; therefore m∠BDA = m∠ABD = 55°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是四边形 ABCD，A 在左上，B 在右上，C 在右下，D 在左下，整体标注为菱形；从 B 到 D 画有一条对角线，从 A 到 C 也画有一条对角线，两条对角线相交于点 E。推理：已知 m∠ABD = 55°。在菱形中，对角线 BD 会平分顶点 B 和顶点 D 的角，所以 ∠ABD 是 ∠ABC 的一半，∠BDA 是 ∠CDA 的一半。菱形的对角相等，因此 ∠ABC = ∠CDA，它们的一半也相等，所以 m∠BDA = m∠ABD = 55°。
